8102.title: Unbounded plugin file loading serializes startup
8102.rootCauseOneLine: Plugin file reads occur before the factory timeout; serial startup and lifecycle locks then stall later plugins and safe-mode completion.
8102.proposedFix: Define cancellable preparation and candidate cleanup, isolate unrelated startup, and handle non-cancellable module loading before releasing lifecycle locks.
8102.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts. Linux external-prebuilt fixture; macOS path-plugin/File Provider, UI and cache-prune claims unverified. Full reproduction source and output inline per report repository policy.
